Definition: properly, to cover up; used only figuratively, to act covertly, i.e. treacherously
BiblicalUsage: 1) to act unfaithfully, act treacherously, transgress, commit a trespass; 1a) (Qal) to act unfaithfully or treacherously; 1a1) against man; 1a2) against God; 1a3) against devoted thing; 1a4) against husband
